prompt:
The section sections/rich-text-escaped.liquid prints merchant text without escaping and never shows the button that the merchant configures. Fix the markup. Keep the {% schema %} block exactly as it is, byte for byte. Inputs. All of them are under section.settings and every key is always supplied: - section.settings.heading: string or null - section.settings.text: string or null - section.settings.button_label: string or null - section.settings.button_link: string or null Required output. It must be a single line with no whitespace between tags:

HEADING

TEXT

BUTTON
Rules: - HEADING is the heading, HTML-escaped with the core `escape` filter. TEXT is the text, escaped the same way. The filter converts & < > " ' to & < > " '. - Escaping always applies, even to text that already contains entities. For example, "&" must become "&". - A null heading or null text produces empty element content. The h2 and the p are always output. - BUTTON is LABEL. - LINK is button_link escaped with `escape`. LABEL is button_label escaped with `escape`. - BUTTON is output only when button_label and button_link are both non-null and both are not the empty string "". Otherwise nothing is output in its place. - Values are not stripped. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/rich-text-escaped.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
